speaker: Enzo Maresca
quote_text:
How important was that Pedro Neto goal and how  much does that change the outlook of the season  
when you compete with Champions League football?  Personally, the goal from Pedro doesn't change my  
view from the season. I said three, four days  ago and I will repeat, Chelsea the last two  
years never been in Champions League spot and this  season we spent all season there. So today's win  
doesn't change my view. It's already a good season  and can become very good if we finish Champions  
League spot, no doubt. But for sure today was an  important win because first of all it's a derby,  
second give us the chance to be there and probably  was the most difficult win and the reason why is  
because they all played yesterday. So for us  it was a must-win game. And I think after we  
conceded the goal is the reason why we struggle a  little bit more, because for the players it become  
more difficult. And second-half we were much  better. Looking at the celebrations, it looked  
special in your end and the players enjoyed it.  Can that give a lot of belief to the squad? And  
can you also explain, like you celebrate for a  little bit, but then you went instant on all.  
Can you explain your feelings as well after  that? No, I was very happy. First of all,  
because it's a nice feeling to win the game  at the end. But I think it was a moment for  
the players because they deserve to share that  moment with the fans. So this is the reason why  
I left the pitch immediately. And then when we  scored the second one, I celebrated and this is  
the reason why they gave me a yellow card. But  for sure, I think it was a nice moment for the  
players and for the fans to share that moment.  It's important. And I said already many times,  
the players, they need to feel the support. And  if? The celebration, was there a lot of relief  
in there as well because you got the win but they  left it late. Did you think it might never come?  
The win? No, to be honest, I was quite positive  because I think the team was creating chances,  
was doing well. Sometimes you also have to be a  little bit lucky. I think Tyrique's goal gave us  
an extra energy, an extra boost. But I was quite  positive because the team was performing well,  
so I was quite positive. And were you impressed  by the Neto goal? If there wasn't a net there,  
that would probably still be travelling.  Yeah, it was a fantastic goal from Pedro,  
from Tyrique, but I think all the team today  was very good. Trevoh was good, Levi was good,  
the one in the middle, Moi, Enzo, Cole was  better, so happy for all of them. Peter. Just  
on the Neto's goal, it's played out from the  back, it's gone the whole way up to the pitch,  
and I know it probably gets lost in the emotion,  but in terms of the goal itself, surely you must  
be pleased with the way it was constructed, which  I know has come under a lot of talk about starting  
to play, but score a goal like that. Yeah, no, no,  very, very, very, very pleased about, as you said,  
about the way you want to play or the style. There  are many different things. But I think in the way  
we want to play, we are there. So it's good also  for the player to score that goal. And as I said,  
fantastic moment to share that moment with  the fans. Jacob, you said on Thursday that  
you wouldn't qualify for the Champions League if  you didn't have Jackson and Mr. Palmer to start  
scoring. So how satisfying is it that you got  to other people stepping up? Yeah, fortunately,  
it was not Cucu again, of course. Yeah, very  happy for Tyrique. Tyrique and Josh Acheampong,  
both from the academy, we decided to promote them  because they are good talent, they have to work  
hard. And Pedro, we all know that Pedro is better  in the right side, but we have also Noni, we have  
also Jadon, so I try to decide game by game. But  Pedro is doing well since he arrived here. How big  
was that Tyrique George goal as well? How big  was that goal? Because it sort of... No, yeah,  
it was. I think we deserved to score. We deserved  to score one goal. It was just the way. And I  
think Tyrique, when he scored, was a nice moment,  but also gave an extra, I think, extra energy to  
the players to try to win the game in the last  minute. Kieran. Hi, can I just check if it was  
Nkunku without the squad because of an injury?  No, it's just a technical decision. You got caught  
in possession. How did you? Fantastic. Very happy  because he played 90 minutes two days ago and play  
again 45. So for us as a team, it's an important  moment because we can start to think about him  
every three days. And this is fantastic for us  because he is our captain, he's a main player,  
fantastic player, so it's good news. Then, yeah,  it can happen. We conceded the first goal when  
he lost the ball, it can happen. And the reason  why we changed him was just because he played 90  
minutes two days ago, 45, and that was the plan.  And we're finished with Ian. That unfortunately  
is not a good one. Muscle problem. And you can  see against Ipswich, second-half. He was inside,  
changed the game. Today he was inside, changed  the game. How important is Malo Gusto for us.  
And unfortunately, he looks muscle injury.  Okay, thanks guys. Thank you. Thank you.
title: Enzo Maresca post-match press conference | Fulham 1-2 Chelsea
